description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git rebase --merge' functionality. It sets up various git repositories, performs different rebase and merge operations, and checks their outcomes. The script contains multiple test cases, setup commands, and assertions to ensure correct behavior of git rebase with the --merge strategy.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case, runs the provided commands, and checks their success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command matches a given pattern.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for a particular test repository.
